text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan'second son Prince Rachid gives go-ahead for works to build 70 km (45 miles) highway linking Casablanca to nearby city of Settat.
- Closing day for registration of candidates for elections of local councils.
- European Fisheries Commissioner Emma Bonino says "Morocco has sovereignty over its waters" but it will not be easy to get EU fishing vessels out as Morocco is dependent on fishing rights fees.
- Labour and Social Affairs Ministry considers applying to the whole country the literacy programme initiated jointly with the World Bank.

- Only the two main state-owned advertising firms will pay a new tax to fund television and cinema productions, which will represent five percent of their annual turnover while other agencies will be exempted.
